roles_as_listed: Vice President and Chief Technology Officer, General Manager of LearningOptics Subsidiary
company_context: A publisher of hard-skills online multimedia training, tools, and assessments for the industrial, medical, and education industries.
summary_paragraphs: Geolux was founded in December 2001 by combining three independent companies serving distinct markets. Developed advanced multimedia content for the subsidiaries. Created a consolidated technology platform for e-learning content authoring, delivery, and management to serve all subsidiaries. The content and platform supported advanced industrial training for companies such as Ford and Boeing. Began piloting the platform with outside customers through the LearningOptics subsidiary. Negotiated the spinout of LearningOptics as an independent company that was later renamed PointeCast.
